scope_limits: No new native or mesher call, generated geometry, measured curve access, raw primitive parsing, model fitting or release was performed.
No full workflow preflight was run here because it hashes saved raw primitives. The separate root preflight still must establish all actual archived paths/runtime inputs.
The closeout receipt explicitly excludes its own final fsync from the observed result-publication interval. No hard-real-time or power-loss guarantee is inferred.
RSS/output checks are sampled; between-sample peaks may be missed. Forecast capacities and scientific sensitivity remain as in the prior review, not newly established bounds.
A failed final uniform test is terminal; favorable execution can nominate only separate temporal review. Historical failed gates and physical-fidelity requirements remain unchanged.

tests.scope: Source metadata, strict declaration, scalar controls, parser dispatch without any log fixture, publication bytes/timing/refusals. Timings are software-test timing, not native performance.

verified_implementation: Exact declaration bytes plus canonical fingerprint reject altered budgets, parser ceilings, flags or triplet window.
Twenty executing modules (17 unchanged and 3 new) plus six declarations must match an exact 26-file Git archive, paths and commit. Archive creation and actual preflight remain separate work.
No native imports or native calls at import. Only explicit --execute launches an authorized source/interpreter/runtime-bound phase; default performs metadata verification only.
Preparation and solve use fresh phase markers/directories; one Gmsh generation and one solve are counted. No resume, alternate mesh, retry or automatic continuation exists.
Solve release must bind both immutable preparation result and its accepted publication check; preparation source, runtime, mesh generation, counts and deck are reverified before solve.

1500 s per solve is clipped to remaining 1800 s aggregate allowance. Preparation has its own inclusive 60 s cap. Worker family RSS is sampled at 3 GiB; output watcher samples 768 MiB active and 2 GiB total.

New native primitive authentication and parser dispatch both require 39610 nodes/9 fields, 34992 elements/8 fields, 61 states; 384 MiB node, 256 MiB element and 16 MiB solver ceilings. Legacy limits remain unchanged.

Readout retains complete synchronized states, solver residual, half and reconstructed-full physics, force/energy reconstruction, sampled Jacobians, work-energy, primitive consistency and 75 physical probes.

All 60 nonrest states require both latest limits. Unequal-spacing history includes 8/12/16, 12/16/24, 16/24/32 and 24/32/36; older limits and N32 failed comparison remain explicit. Drift and limit disagreement stay separate.
Only candidate_for_temporal_review may become true. spatial_convergence_accepted, finest_level_step_convergence_evaluated and calibration_released remain false; physical_validation_pass remains null.

Durable result publication includes file fsync, directory fsync and retained-byte scan in the timing gate. A separate closeout binds exact result bytes and total bytes including itself; missing/failed closeout prevents acceptance.
